data: Your imbued ability charges up over time with bonus spirit damage, bonus fire rate, and reloads bullets on use.
Allows an additional use of Air Jump or Air Dash before landing.
Dealing significant spirit damage to an enemy within 5s causes an explosion dealing damage and a burn to that enemy. While burning, enemies take damage over time and receive reduced healing.
The cooldown is per enemy, so each target can only be burned once per cooldown. Deals half-damage on non-heroes.
Each hero kill grants permanent Fire Rate (up to a max of 8 times). Death results in the loss of 1 stack.
Your bullets build up a Movement Slow on enemies.
Damage from your ultimate applies a stun and deals bonus spirit damage after a short delay.
Launch an expanding projectile which Silences enemies for a short duration and deals impact damage.
Silence does not interrupt channeling abilities.
Reset the cooldown of the imbued non-ultimate ability.
This item's cooldown is increased by the cooldown of the imbued ability.
Launch a projectile that deals damage, applies a strong slow that recovers over time, prevents Stamina usage and Silences their movement-based items and abilities.
Bonus Spirit Power for Charged Abilities
Reduces the duration of all negative effects applied to you.
When the target takes spirit damage, they have their Move Speed reduced.
You enter a void state and become untargetable and invincible for a short duration, during which lasers blast out and rotate around you.
Your Melee Attack applies Movement Slow and heals you for a percentage of the Melee Damage dealt plus a fixed amount.
This heal is 40% effective vs non-heroes.
Cooldown is 1.5x as long for Light Melee hits.
Your bullets have a chance to be empowered, causing them to deal bonus weapon damage on hit.
Grants Fire Rate, Spirit Resistance and Move Speed, and removes the Move Speed penalty while shooting, but Silences you and disables stamina usage and regeneration.
Applying heal to yourself or an ally grants the target bonus fire rate and bonus move speed.
Does not apply on innate Regen or passive Bullet/Spirit Lifesteals.
Your next Melee attack heals you.
This heal is 30% effective vs non-heroes.
Dealing spirit damage to enemy Heroes grants you Bonus regeneration. Stacks when dealing damage to different heroes.
Throw a flask that explodes on contact, creating an area that does increasing spirit damage per second and reduces enemy Bullet Resist.
The next instance of high spirit damage you take is significantly reduced.
Release an expanding ice blast that deals spirit damage and Slows targets it hits.
Your bullets build up to reduce the target's outgoing damage and apply healing reduction.
When an enemy uses an ability within 32mm range from you, store one Restoration Stack.
Consume all stacks to heal yourself and replenish up to 3 stamina based on how many stacks you have.
When below 50% health, gain additional Spirit Resist.
Increases Weapon Damage as you continuously fire your weapon.
Increases the effectiveness of your healing.
When you are above 65% health, deal additional Weapon Damage and your bullets reduce enemy Bullet Resist.
Heal and gain bonus Movement Speed for a short duration when you cast an ability.
Reduces Bullet Resist on enemies when you deal spirit damage.
When below 50% health, gain additional Bullet Resist.
Temporarily suppress negative status effects and become immune to Stun, Silence, Sleep, Root, and Disarm.
Cannot be used while Stunned or Slept.
Purge all non-ultimate negative effects currently applied to you. If any effects were removed, heal yourself and gain a move speed bonus.
Release an expanding ice blast that deals spirit damage, Freezing and then Slowing targets it hits.
Slowed targets have their stamina regen frozen

Your imbued ability charges up over time with bonus spirit damage, bonus fire rate, and reloads bullets on use. Until your next reload, your bullets deal bonus spirit damage based on your Spirit Power.
When you Dash-Jump you gain Fire Rate and bonus Ammo until your next reload. Lasts up to 7s.
Channel an expanding storm cloud around you that damages all enemies within its radius. Enemies do not take damage when they are out of line-of-sight.
+55% Bullet Resist while channeling Storm Cloud

Use your scoped rifle to fire a powerful shot over long distances. Deal only partial damage until fully charged after 1.0s of being scoped. Does bonus damage to enemies with less than 50% health remaining. Landing a killing blow on a player with Assassinate grants you bonus weapon damage.
Drain health from nearby enemies, dealing spirit damage over time and healing for a portion of the damage dealt.
+2m Radius and +18.0 DPS with improved Spirit scaling
Charge forward, pulling enemies you hit. Pushing a hero into a wall applies stun.
If you collide with a hero you move faster during your charge.
On Hero Collide: +1.5 Weapon Damage for 6s
Leap high into the air before crashing into the ground, dealing spirit damage and applying stun.
On cast, become Unstoppable for 5s and +6m Impact Radius
Deploy a turret that shoots enemies, dealing spirit damage over time. The turret expires after a limited lifetime.
Turrets deal reduced damage to troopers and objectives.
+25% Turret Fire Rate and +12s Turret Lifetime
Deploy a spirit that provides healing to nearby allies.
While channeling, restore health over time to you and any allies nearby.
You can dash and melee without breaking the channel.
Aura provides +4m Move Speed during channel
Full move and ability use and additionally heals +2.5% of Max Health per second
Create a singularity in your hands, dealing spirit damage over time, applying stun, and pulling in nearby enemies.
Kelvin creates a floating trail of ice and snow that gives movement bonuses to him and his allies. Kelvin gains 60% slow resistance for the duration. Enemies can also walk on the floating trail.
Press Dash / Crouch / slide to travel up or down while in Ice Path.
+2m Move Speed and +35% Bullet Resist for Kelvin while on Ice Path
+35% Spirit and +20 Spirit for Kelvin while on Ice Path
Target yourself or a Hero to freeze the air and create an impenetrable dome around them. While in the dome, allies gain rapid regeneration and enemies are slowed.
Objectives becomes Invulnerable and Frozen under Frozen Shelter
Purges non-ult debuffs for you and your allies.
+65 Health Regen and increased Spirit Scaling
Drop a bounce pad in the world that launches any hero.
You explode on landing, dealing Damage to any nearby enemies.
The explosion can only occur once per person per Bounce Pad.
You and allies gain a +4m/s move speed bonus for 4s on landing
Deal melee damage to nearby enemies and apply knockback.
When they land, they deal spirit damage and apply reduced fire rate to other nearby enemies.
Exploding Uppercut can be used on allies.
On Hero Hit: Gain fast spin-up time, 2x weapon range and +30% weapon damage for 9s
On Hero Hit: Set Grapple Arm cooldown to 0 and restores +18% of your missing health
Attach a bomb that explodes after a delay, dealing spirit damage to nearby enemies.
If the bomb hits or kills a hero, you gain permanent bonus damage on Sticky Bomb.
Stacks diminish by half after 60 hits and 7 kills
On Cast: +5m Move Speed and +25% Debuff Resistance for 6s
Instantly turn to shadows, becoming untargetable, gaining bonus move speed, and dealing spirit damage.
After a delay, return from the shadows, dealing spirit damage again.
On Completion: Heal for 450 and refund all ability cooldowns
Launches you high in the air, allowing you to glide slowly. While airborne, you gain Weapon Damage and multishot on your weapon.
Press Jump / mantle to cancel the glide.
While airborne, +3 Weapon Damage and weapon damage applies 24% movement slow for 1.5s
While airborne, +30% Bullet Lifesteal, +30% Spirit Lifesteal and +30% Bullet Evasion

Throw out a trap that begins to arm itself. Once armed, the trap will trigger when an enemy enters its radius, applying Curse and Movement Slow that interrupts, Silences, Disarms, and prevents item usage.
Hit the trap with a Charged Shot to detonate early with increased radius.
After 1.5s cast time, launch a spirit owl that you control and which explodes on impact, damaging and stunning enemies. Hold [W] to accelerate the owl.
Press Jump / mantle to release control. Gain permanent Spirit Power for each enemy hero killed with Guided Owl.
After hit, kills enemies that are below 22% Health
Throw a knife that bleeds an enemy. Each additional hit adds a stack and refreshes the bleed duration, causing the bleed to increase per stack.
+12.0 Bleed DPS with increased Spirit scaling
Grab an ally and take flight with them. Drop your ally to cause an explosion, dealing spirit damage. You and your ally gain increased Outgoing Damage when flying ends.
Cooldown reduced by 30% when used on allies.
Taking damage briefly disables using the ability.
While lifted, your ally cannot attack and deals -20% damage.
On Fly End : 300 Barrier to Ivy and ally that scales with Spirit
After charging for 2s, release pulses that damage enemies and heal you based on the damage done.
While channeling Last Stand you have greatly increased bullet and spirit resist.
Stomp the ground beneath you, damaging enemies in front of you. If you perform Ground Strike while airborne, you quickly dive towards the ground. Damage grows slower after 25m.
Struck enemies are knocked up and slowed by 40% for 3s
Damage Per Meter +120% and improved scaling
Pull yourself through the air toward a target. Using Grapple also resets your limit of air jumps and dashes.
+20m Cast Range and gain +7.0 Weapon Damage for 6s
Strike enemies in front of you with your whip, healing for a portion of the damage dealt.

Focus on enemies to connect whips to them. After channeling, connected enemies are lifted and stunned then slammed into the ground. Your victims and any enemies in the landing zone will be damaged and slowed.
Press to throw connected enemies early. Enemies that are not in line of sight or go out of range during the latch time will not be grabbed.

Encase the target in a cube of restorative goo that protects from damage, and increases health regen. Target is unable to take any new actions while cubed. Can be used on self. Press Jump / mantle to escape early.
Increases Move Speed and Stamina Recovery
Removes all non-ult Debuffs and -20.0s Cooldown
Materialize a fist in the world that punches everyone in the area, applying knockup.
Punching an enemy deals melee damage and applies slow.
You and your allies have increased Air Control.
-14.0s Cooldown and now deals Heavy Melee Damage
Throw a dagger, dealing spirit damage and applying slow.
Every subsequent dagger against the same target stacks in spirit damage and slow.
On Hit: -8% Bullet Resist and -6% Bullet Resist per Stack
Inject a target with lethal venom. After a delay the venom triggers, dealing Spirit Damage. The damage is increased by the target's missing health.
Lethal Venom will ignore Petrify's damage block.
Bullets also build up Lethal Venom
Throw an explosive bola. On exploding, the bola Slows and Damages all enemies in the area.
Direct hits deal Additional Damage and Petrify instead. Petrified units block all damage, but cannot take actions.
+1.0s Petrify Duration. Petrifies all enemies in the area.
Your bullets apply additional spirit damage. Dealing damage your abilities builds up to a vicious bite, dealing a burst of bonus spirit damage.
Love Bites has a unique cooldown per target.
Send out a mark that bleeds the first target it hits, dealing spirit damage over time.
While the enemy is bleeding you can re-activate Stalker's Mark to instantly appear behind their back.
Surround nearby enemy heroes in darkness, severely limiting their vision of other units. Affected enemies are briefly revealed to you and are considered isolated for the duration.
Fire a grenade that bounces before exploding, dealing weapon damage and setting enemies on fire.
Burning targets deal pure damage to enemies in the area and suffer from reduced healing.
Fire a blast with your shotgun, dealing weapon damage and pushing enemies back. Enemies near a wall receive stun and take bonus weapon damage.
On Wall Stun: Your next heavy melee is blessed
Kick a trap that arms after a brief delay.
The trap springs on the first enemy it touches, dealing spirit damage, applying immobilize, and revealing enemies for a duration afterwards.
Load your crossbow with 3 stakes, dealing massively increased weapon damage.
The final stake is blessed, dealing bonus pure damage and executing low-health enemies.
While Active: Gain 1.2 m/s Move Speed
Unleash pain, dealing spirit damage over time to both enemies and yourself.
The damage continues to increase the longer the ability is channeled, up to a maximum amount.
Enemies receive 20% Move and Dash Slow
Target an area with latent magic, applying slow.
The magic detonates after a delay, dealing spirit damage and applying immobilize.
On Hit: Reduce Spirit Resist by -18% for 6s
Chain nearby enemies to you. Chained enemies cannot use movement abilities and receive a heavy slow when they pull on the chain.
After a delay, yank everyone towards Billy and deal spirit damage.
The chain breaks if you lose line of sight for a short while.
+1.3s of Unstoppable Per Hero pulled in
Passive: Collect death when anything dies nearby and store it in your Jar of Dead.
Active: Throw a jar to summon Deadheads that repeatedly deal spirit damage to enemies.
Deadheads follow you instead if there's no nearby enemies, and prioritize the target of your weapon.
Collecting death heals 5 health per pickup
Unearth a line of grasping hands, summoning a Ghoul and leaving behind a rift. Enemies who pass through take spirit damage and receive immobilize.
Alt-Cast rotates the orientation of the wall.
On Death: Deal +5% Current Health as Damage
Draw a sigil sphere in front of you and then leap backwards as it explodes, damaging and slowing enemies caught in it.
Gain +25% Fire Rate and +25% Bullet Speed for 8s
On Player Hit: +1 stamina restored and resets Air Jump/Dash limit

Perform a series of lunges in any direction, delivering piercing stabs ahead of you. Hold your ability key to time your attacks, dealing more damage the longer it's held. Releasing your attack during the perfect window deals maximum damage.
-12s Cooldown. Gain +60% Bullet Resist during lunge
+65 Perfect Damage with improved Spirit scaling.

Charge up and perform a long range slash. Struck enemies cannot take action or heal and are stuck in slow motion. When this effect expires, they suffer devastating damage, dealing bonus damage against half-health enemies.
While in slow motion, Apollo is invulnerable and enemies take reduced damage.
Hold Ability 4 or to delay the cast.
Throw your trusty pillow inflicting spirit damage and heavy knockback.
Landing hits reduces the cooldown of your other abilities.
Jump to an ally and nap alongside them. Both you and the ally receive a burst heal based on missing health followed by lingering regeneration.
Hop between allies with Ability 2 to apply the heal, once per ally.
You are knocked off if stunned by an ultimate ability.
You can use items and all self-casts target your ally instead.
35% Bonus Item Range, Duration, and Barrier Effectiveness while napping
+15% Spirit Power and +35 Spirit Power while napping and for 10s after napping
Signal a Helper to lend a hand. They can collect boxes, do Sinner's Sacrifices, or be sent to support allies and troopers.
Follow a hero: Provides a short burst of spirit resist and fading move speed.
Follow a trooper: Provides healing, damage, resists, and allows tagging along. When no hero is around, souls from trooper kills are split amongst the team.
Can be cast during Tag Along. Helpers will take a nap for 15.1s after following someone.
Cast your gaze forward, piercing walls and floors. Enemies in the gaze are slowed, have reduced dash distance, and cannot use movement abilities.
When the channel ends they fall asleep before waking up to a splitting headache that deals heavy spirit damage.
-1 Stamina On Wake and no Stamina Regen while sleeping
Reduced damage and unstoppable while channeling
Instantly reload your gun. You gain bonus fire rate and deal bonus weapon damage based on the target's health for a limited number of shots, but suffer from reduced accuracy.
Deals bonus Weapon Damage against troopers and neutrals.
If you hit all shots, deal +7% current health as damage
+80 Bonus Damage and kicked enemies deal -35% Damage for 5s
Throw a bola, dealing spirit damage, applying slow and preventing movement abilities or stamina.
Passive: Dealing damage generates bloodlust, increased at low health. At max bloodlust, you automatically cast Lycan Curse.
Active: Instantly transform, gaining increased max health, and stacking fire rate on enemy heroes, and replacing your abilities and weapon with their ferocious versions.
+4 m/s Move Speed and 200 Bonus Health
On Hero Kill: Refresh abilities and duration
Blast enemies in a cone in front of you with a flare of light. Blasted enemies take spirit damage when attacked by Celeste and provides her spirit lifesteal.
Surround yourself in a protective prism. If the barrier is destroyed, it silences nearby enemies and deals a portion of the barrier as damage.
+70 Barrier and Increased Barrier Spirit Scaling
+1.25 Silence Duration and -20s Cooldown. Allows Shining Wonder Bounce.
Call down a beam of light from the sky. After a short duration, the beam will fully form, causing an explosion that deals spirit damage to all targets in the area.
Celeste will receive a stacking buff that increases her spirit damage anytime this hits an enemy hero.

Launch a deadly orb of light that deals spirit damage and applies slow and reduces Dash Distance on impact. The orb then bounces to the enemies within range. If no target is found, the orb will linger for a short duration while continuing to look for targets.
Prioritizes enemy heroes when picking targets.
Previous recorded cooldown change: 100s to 90s, October 2nd, 2025.
Return to Shadows cooldown reduced from 90s to 60s
Previous recorded cooldown change: 135s to 120s, July 29th, 2025.
Guided Owl cooldown reduced from 120s to 110s
Previous recorded cooldown change: 24s to 20s, July 29th, 2025.
